safe.body: Your bookings, your availability, and your invitations all stay exactly as they are.
safe.title: Nothing is lost

shifts.body: Everything you said yes to, soonest first.

password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

email.description: You sign in with it, and the verification link goes here.

invite.body: An invitation link takes you straight in — otherwise you ask to join a public event.
